verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm LangChain's docs serve an llms.txt index (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of the LangGraph pages. Each .md page tells agents to fetch the complete documentation index from llms.txt, and the llms.txt also lists the Agent Server OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant or first-party guidance on pointing coding agents at these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.langchain.com/llms.txt # Docs by LangChain
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.langchain.com/llms.txt
The docs llms.txt lists it under "## OpenAPI Specs" as "[agent-server-openapi](/langsmith/agent-server-openapi.json)"
